sentences.text: The review petitioner in both petitions is the Executive Engineer of the Zilla Panchayath Engineering Division, Ballari.
2. He seeks review of the order dated 02.03.2021 in MFA.No.102006/2015 connected with MFA.No.102008/2015 (LAC) by filing these two review petitions.

3. After perusing the records what we find is that in the guise of seeking review of the order in two miscellaneous first appeals, actually he wants to challenge the order dated 02.01.2012 in Civil Misc. Case Nos.23 and 24 of 2010 on the file of I Additional Senior Civil Judge, Ballari.

entities.text: Civil Misc. Case Nos.23 and 24 of 2010
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: I Additional Senior Civil Judge, Ballari
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By passing the order in Civil Misc. Case Nos.23 and 24 of 2010, the Senior Civil Judge allowed the applications under Section 18(3)(b) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 ("L.A. Act" for short) and directed the Land Acquisition Officer to make a reference to the civil NC: 2024:KHC-D:18111-DB court.

entities.text: Civil Misc. Case Nos.23 and 24 of 2010
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: In the said proceedings, question of limitation was raised, but the learned Senior Civil Judge held that reference was not time barred.

Now in the review petitions, it is contended that since the claimants did not make an application under Section 18(3) of the L.A.
Act within 90 days from the date of receipt of notice under Section 12(2) of the L.A.
Act, the reference court should not have entertained the claim for enhancement of compensation.
Therefore, it is clear that the review is sought indirectly with reference to the order dated 02.01.2012 in Civil Misc. Case Nos.23 and 24 of 2010.

entities.text: Civil Misc. Case Nos.23 and 24 of 2010
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The said orders should have been challenged separately.
Review for this purpose is not maintainable.
Therefore review petitions are dismissed.
